findings.title: Module header still says shipping is summarised at the standard rate
findings.why: The header comment says the VAT summary shows 'shipping at the standard rate'. The change made shipping 0% in `vatSummary`, and the README now says shipping carries no VAT, so the comment contradicts both.

findings.title: VAT_RATES import is now unused
findings.why: `vatSummary` no longer uses `VAT_RATES`, because shipping is added with a literal rate of 0. The import is dead. tsconfig has no `noUnusedLocals`, so it won't fail the build.

findings.title: Decision record claims the code already used >= and that there is no behaviour change
findings.why: The record says the code already ships free at goods >= €50.00 and that the decision is 'No behaviour change'. In the first commit, `shippingCost` used `goods > FREE_SHIPPING_FROM_CENTS`. This same change switches it to `>=`, so the record misdescribes the change it ships with.
